verdict.rationale: incident.io's postmortem-ai feature explicitly generates first drafts of postmortems with inline review suggestions and redraft options, timelines are auto-generated from key events with narrative additions, and follow-ups are tracked as a distinct actionable category — together covering timeline, contributing factors, and follow-ups ready for human review. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation showing contributing-factors analysis specifically named as an AI-drafted section, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of draft quality beyond vendor docs.
